issues.legal_issue: Constructive res judicata does not bar a public interest challenge to government memoranda that were not challenged in earlier litigation and give rise to a separate cause of action.

Article 14 prohibits the State from allotting public land at discounted basic rates to privileged occupational categories as a separate class when the classification is arbitrary and fails substantive equality.
Statutory provisions permitting assignment or alienation of public land do not authorize allotments that violate the equality guarantee in Article 14.
